articles.title: Dubai-based crypto exchange tied to $4 billion Iran sanctioned-evasion network
articles.snippet: Shelbit allegedly sent hundreds of millions of dollars to major crypto exchanges, including Binance, as it linked gambling sites and sanctioned Iranian entities to global crypto markets.

articles.title: Global banks test tokenized money for cross-border payments in $1 million BIS pilot
articles.snippet: Twenty-eight banks, including JPMorgan, Citi and UBS, moved real money across borders in a live test of blockchain-based settlement.

articles.title: Circle receives New York trust charter for subsidiary
articles.snippet: The New York trust charter allows Circle’s subsidiary to provide fiduciary and custody services under state banking law.

articles.title: Citadel buys bulk of Situational Awareness stock portfolio after AI rout: Reports
articles.snippet: Situational Awareness retained about $10 billion in assets, including its Anthropic stake, after reportedly selling leveraged public stock positions to Ken Griffin’s Citadel.

articles.title: New York sues Kalshi over alleged illegal gambling operation
articles.snippet: The lawsuit adds to a growing clash between New York and the CFTC over whether federally regulated prediction markets are subject to state gambling laws.
